rubric.role_summary: Content coordination role at an EdTech company, managing content updates, freelance contributors, feedback, rights and permissions, and operational tracking across content, product, and technology teams.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Content coordination role at an EdTech company, managing content updates, freelance contributors, feedback, rights and permissions, and operational tracking across content, product, and technology teams.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Background in content coordination, project coordination, or operations.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Background within tech, product, digital publishing, or EdTech.
- Experience building a tracker or system to manage competing priorities.
- Proven ability to keep multiple workstreams organized and moving.
- Skill in turning scattered information into patterns and concrete recommendations.
- Experience using AI tools to enhance creativity, decisions, and execution.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Sweden. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
